episodes.title: The Cartographer of Missing Streets
episodes.premise: Episode 01: Undeliverable. A courier discovers that a missing bridge has arrived in her delivery basket.

panels.scene: Ika brakes her bicycle at a vanished bridge on a rainy city river.
panels.caption: At 6:14, Bridge Street disappeared.

panels.scene: Close-up of Ika in her orange rain jacket.
panels.dialogue: That is going to make me late.

panels.scene: A tiny glowing streetlamp emerges from the parcel in her basket.
panels.dialogue: Please do not mark me undeliverable.

panels.scene: Ika opens the parcel beneath a bakery awning.
panels.dialogue: Who ordered a talking bridge? Someone who remembers where I belong.
There is no house there anymore.

panels.scene: Inside the parcel, a glowing miniature road leads to a blue door.
panels.dialogue: A house is not the same thing as a way home.

panels.scene: Ika pedals over a luminous bridge forming beneath her wheels toward a portal.
panels.caption: To be continued.
panels.dialogue: Fine. But you are signing for this.
